mapper.insert: INSERT INTO logan_config (app_id,config_key,config_value,enabled,version,remark,add_time) VALUES (#{appId},#{configKey},#{configValue},#{enabled},#{version},#{remark},#{addTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE config_value = VALUES(config_value), enabled = VALUES(enabled), version = VALUES(version), remark = VALUES(remark)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM logan_config WHERE app_id=#{appId} ORDER BY enabled DESC, config_key ASC
SELECT * FROM logan_config WHERE app_id=#{appId} AND version > #{sinceVersion} ORDER BY version ASC
SELECT seq FROM logan_config_seq WHERE app_id=#{appId}
mapper.update: UPDATE logan_config_seq SET seq = seq + 1 WHERE app_id=#{appId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO logan_config_seq (app_id, seq) VALUES (#{appId}, 0)
